thought.text: All 4 checklist items in the guide are currently passing (the Chrome / Linux desktop item is not required by the guide — the guide targets Android/iOS). Next up is the guide's other requirement: a virtual device that can launch. Since KVM is available, I'll start the emulator in the background:

reasoning_content:
All four required checklist items from the guide passed:
- [✓] Flutter (3.35.7, Dart 3.9.2)
- [✓] Android toolchain (SDK 36.0.0, Java 17, licenses accepted)
- [✓] Android Studio (version 2026.2.1.8)
- Xcode: N/A (not a Mac)

The remaining failures (Chrome for Web, Linux desktop toolchain) are not required per the guide.

Next, let's start up the emulator (the guide requires "a virtual device that can start and be connected"). /dev/kvm exists. Launch it with -no-window -no-audio -gpu swiftshader_indirect (or auto). KVM acceleration: check /dev/kvm permissions — since I'm root, no problem.

Then, build the debug APK:
fvm flutter build apk --debug --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true

Actually, I could also do `flutter build apk --debug --flavor ni`. The dart-define values are used at runtime for partner selection, and for the build they're just embedded. I'll include them to match the run config.

First, let's start the emulator in the background.

action.command: export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && nohup /opt/android-sdk/emulator/emulator -avd umweltnavi_avd -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot > /tmp/emu.log 2>&1 & echo "started pid $!"; sleep 15; tail -5 /tmp/emu.log
